book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: Yɨɨsu arooja abhɨɨga bhaazɨ amagʉrʉ

Mmbe hanʉ isigukuru yɨ Ɨpasaka yaarɨ ɨkɨɨrɨ kuhika, Yɨɨsu akamenya ribhaga ryazɨ ryu ukurwa kʉʉsɨ kuja kwa Wiisɨ rihikirɨ. Yɨɨsu aarɨ abhasɨɨgirɨ abhaatʉ bhaazɨ bhanʉ bhaarɨ kʉʉsɨ, na akabhasɨɨga kuhika ɨtɨnɨrʉ.
Yɨɨsu na abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakiikara kurya ibhyakurya bhya rigoroobha. Ribhaga riyo, Shɨtaani aarɨ amarirɨ kokorokomba Yuuda, umwana wa Simʉʉni Isikariyʉʉti, korereke ichʉrɨ Yɨɨsu.
Yɨɨsu akamenya Wiisɨ akamoha ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉ ʉkʉkangata ebhegero bhyʉsi. Na akamenya kʉbha ewe akarwa kwa Mungu, na aragarʉka kwa Mungu.
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akarwa kubhyakurya, akiimɨɨrɨra, akaruusha ɨkanzʉ yaazɨ yi igʉrʉ, akagega ɨkɨsagi akiibhoha mukiribhizi.
Akʉmara akatʉʉra amanzi mʉbhakuri. Akatanga kwoja abhɨɨga bhaazɨ amagʉrʉ na kʉbhataricha nɨ ɨkɨsagi kɨnʉ aarɨ ibhʉhirɨ.
Hanʉ aamuhikiirɨ Simʉʉni Peetero, Peetero akamubhuurya, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, oreenda konyoja inyɨ amagʉrʉ?”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Awɨ ʉtakʉtʉra kwobhoora ganʉ nekokora nangwɨnʉ, nawe ʉragoobhoora ribhaga rɨnʉ rikuuza.”
Peetero akabhuga, “Ʉtakonyoja amagʉrʉ gaanɨ!” Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ nɨtakukwoja, ʉtakʉtʉra kʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ zee.”
Simʉʉni Peetero akabhuga, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, nangʉ ʉtanyoja amagʉrʉ ageene, nawe na amabhoko hamwɨmwɨ nu umutwɨ gwanɨ.”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ isaabhirɨ, atakwenderwa kwisaabha kwikɨ, nawe kwoja amagʉrʉ ageene, kʉ kʉbha ni mwɨrʉ. Na niimwɨ nɨ‑bhɨɨrʉ, nawe mʉtarɨ imwʉsi.”
Yɨɨsu aarɨ amwɨzɨ wʉnʉ araamwichʉrɨ, necho chagiriryɨ akabhuga, “Nawe ɨtarɨ imwʉsi.”
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kobhooja amagʉrʉ, akiibhoha ɨkanzʉ yaazɨ, akiikara naatu hanʉ aarɨ, akabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ, mwʉbhʉʉrirɨ ganʉ nɨbhakʉrɨɨrɨ?
Imwɨ mʉrambɨrɨkɨra, ‘Umwija,’ na mʉrambɨrɨkɨra, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ.’ Mʉragamba amaheene, kʉ kʉbha inyɨ nɨmbu nɨrɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ inyɨ Umwija nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waanyu, nɨbhʉʉjiryɨ amagʉrʉ gaanyu, ereenderwa na niimwɨ mʉbhɨ muriiyoja amagʉrʉ.
Nɨbhɨɨrɨkiryɨ ekerenjo, korereke na niimwɨ mʉbhɨ muriikorera chɨmbu inyɨ nɨbhakʉrɨɨrɨ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, mbʉʉsa atarɨ mʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra umuniibhi waazɨ, na wʉnʉ akutumwa atarɨ mʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra wʉnʉ akʉmʉtʉma.
Mʉraagamenye gayo, nɨ‑hakɨrɨku hanʉ mʉraagakore.

“Nɨtakʉgambɨra ganʉ igʉrʉ waanyu imwʉsi. Nɨbhɨɨzɨ abhaatʉ bhanʉ nɨrʉbhwɨrɨ kʉbha abhɨɨga bhaanɨ. Nawe nɨgambirɨ ganʉ korereke gabhɨ ganʉ gaandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, ‘Mʉsaani waanɨ wʉnʉ aarɨ ararya ibhyakurya hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ, ichurirɨ kʉbha umubhisa waanɨ.’
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra gʉʉsi ganʉ gakɨɨrɨ kʉhʉrʉka, korereke hanʉ gakʉhʉrʉka, mwisiriryɨ inyɨ newe.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ariisiriryɨ wʉnʉ nitumirɨ, anyiisiriiryɨ inyɨ. Ɨbhuɨbhu, wʉnʉ akunyiisirirya, isiriiryɨ Bhaabha wʉnʉ antumirɨ.”
Yɨɨsu aragamba igʉrʉ wa wʉnʉ araamwichʉrɨ
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aagambirɨ gayo, akarumɨka bhʉkʉngʼu mumwʉyʉ, akabhuga, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, wʉmwɨ waanyu aranyiichʉra.”
Abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakatanga kwirorarora, kʉ kʉbha bhataamɨnyirɨ aragamba wɨɨwɨ.
Aareho umwɨga wʉmwɨ, wʉnʉ Yɨɨsu aasɨɨgirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Ewe aarɨ iikɨɨrɨ haguhɨ na Yɨɨsu ribhaga ryu kurya.
Mmbe, Simʉʉni Peetero akasimya umwɨga wuyo, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Mubhuuryɨ arabhuga wɨɨwɨ?”
Mmbe, umwɨga wʉnʉ aarɨ ihɨgɨkirɨku Yɨɨsu, akabhuurya, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ?”
Yɨɨsu akagarukirya, “Nɨ‑wʉnʉ nekoha ɨkɨtɨnɨka chʉ ʉmʉkaatɨ kɨnʉ nekokorya.” Mmbe, akagega ɨkɨtɨnɨka chʉ ʉmʉkaatɨ akakorya mʉbhakuri, akaha Yuuda, umwana wa Simʉʉni Isikariyʉʉti.
Hanʉ Yuuda aamarirɨ kogega ɨkɨtɨnɨka kiyo, Shɨtaani akamusikɨra. Neho Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Ganʉ ukwenda kokora, gakore bhwangʉ!”
Nawe atareeho nʉʉrʉ wʉmwɨ wa bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhararya wʉnʉ aamɨnyirɨ kwakɨ Yɨɨsu akagambabhu.
Abhandɨ bhakakina Yɨɨsu amubhuuriirɨ agʉrɨ bhɨnʉ bhikwenderwa kusigukuru, hamwɨ abhahɨ abhahabhɨ zimpirya ekerengo ekerebhe, kʉ kʉbha newe aarɨ umugwatiriri wɨ ɨkɨgʉzi cha zimpirya.
Mmbe, hanʉ Yuuda aagɨgirɨ ɨkɨtɨnɨka kirya, hayohayo akahʉrʉka igʉtʉ. Ribhaga riyo ryarɨ bhutikʉ.
Yɨɨsu arabhaha abhɨɨga bhaazɨ ubhuswaja ubhuhya

Mmbe hanʉ Yuuda aahurukirɨ igʉtʉ, Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉrɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ, “Nangʉ ukugungibhwa ku Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ kʉraariirɨ kororekana habhwɨrʉ. Nu ukugungibhwa kwa Mungu kʉrarorekana habhwɨrʉ kʉhɨtɨra kwawɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwazɨ bhʉrarorekana kʉhɨtɨra Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ, mmbe Mungu wʉʉsi arabheerecha abhaatʉ ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhu Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ, na arakorabhu bhwangʉ.
“Imwɨ abhaana bhaanɨ, nɨrabha na niimwɨ kwi ibhaga isuuhubhu. Mʉramonhya, nawe chɨmbu nabhuuriirɨ Abhayaahudi, ɨnʉ nikuja imwɨ mʉtakʉtʉra kuuza, nɨmbu nɨkʉbhabhʉʉrɨra na niimwɨ.
Nɨrabhaha ubhuswaja ubhuhya, mʉsɨɨganɨ. Chɨmbu inyɨ nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ, na niimwɨ mʉsɨɨganɨ ɨbhuɨbhu.
Mʉraasɨɨganɨ, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharamenya kʉbha, imwɨ nɨ‑bhɨɨga bhaanɨ.”
Yɨɨsu ararora kʉbha Peetero aramwanga
Mmbe, Simʉʉni Peetero akabhuurya, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, ʉraja hayi?” Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Nɨraja hanʉ awɨ ʉtakʉtʉra kuntuna nangwɨnʉ, nawe ʉrantuna ibhaga rɨndɨ.”
Peetero akamubhuurya, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, kwakɨ nitigɨ kukutuna nangwɨnʉ? Inyɨ nɨrakwa igʉrʉ waazʉ!”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Peetero, maheene uriisirirya kukwa igʉrʉ waanɨ? Nɨrakʉbhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ekorokoome ɨkɨɨrɨ kʉgamba, ʉrabha ʉnyangirɨ manga katatʉ.”

footnotes.text: Inyɨ newe nɨmbu Mungu iitʉndiryɨ kʉBhʉragɨ bhwɨ Ɨkarɨ. Rora Kʉhʉrʉka 3:14; Isaaya 43:10.
